load.failed: Could not read the arcade route data: {{message}}
load.emptyCourseTable: The course table has no rows to use as a template.
load.noWorkspace: Open an EXVS2 Workspace folder first.
load.initialise: Unpack them from the OB data
load.initialiseFailed: Could not unpack the route packages: {{message}}

browser.title: Routes
browser.search: Filter by name or course id
browser.dormantHint: These scenes ship with a script and a briefing but no course plays them. Claiming one is the safest way to add a route: nothing new has to be hashed.
browser.dormantEmpty: Every shipped scene is already used by a course.

wizard.title: New route from unused scenes
wizard.description: Give the scenes a course entry so the arcade select screen offers them.
wizard.courseIdHint: The server decides which course ids are offered. Unused ids above 250 are the usual choice.
wizard.name: Display name
wizard.nameHint: Shown on the select screen. ASCII only, for example A-22.
wizard.sceneNumberHint: Results are reported to the server per scene number, so a fresh range keeps them separate.

course.title: Course
course.description: The select-screen row: name, id, variant and stars.
course.name: Name
course.variantHint: Several rows may share a course id; the variant tells them apart. Opening an existing row is not a clash.
course.unlockServerHint: Type 0 appears only if the server lists it. That is the shipped default.
course.unlockLocked: This course uses unlock type {{type}}, which has not been decompiled. The field is read-only so the shipped behaviour is preserved.

stages.title: Stages
stages.scriptFolderUnknown: This stage has no official scene name, so the unpack folder cannot be named yet.
stages.scriptFolderUnpacked: This package is unpacked in the workspace.
stages.scriptFolderMissing: This package is not unpacked yet. Use Unpack this stage's script in this row.
stages.openScript: Open script in the MSC workspace
stages.scriptNotRead: The mission script has not been read, so the fight and the briefing cannot be compared.
stages.scriptLoadFailed: The mission script could not be read: {{message}}
stages.scriptLoaded: Read {{count}} unit slot(s) from the mission script.
stages.reextractScriptBody: Replace the files for {{name}} in {{path}} from the OB package. Decompiled .c files beside them are left in place.

editor.emptyBody: Pick a course on the left, or claim a group of unused scene slots.

squad.title: Line-up
squad.description: Generate the fight and the briefing that shows it.
squad.enemyCountHint: Hardware testing put the on-screen ceiling at {{max}} enemies.

slots.title: Unit slots
slots.empty: No slots yet. Generate a line-up first.
slots.deadParameterNote: Eleven of the slot parameters are never read by this build, so the editor does not expose them.

briefing.title: Loading screen
briefing.description: What the briefing shows before the fight starts. It does not change what spawns.
briefing.bossSlotsHint: Up to three slots framed as bosses on the enemy side.
briefing.syncFromSquad: Match the briefing to the line-up

validation.title: Checks
validation.clean: Every check that could run passed.
validation.blocked: {{count}} problem(s) must be fixed before saving.
validation.subtitle: Reported, never repaired - what to change is your call.
validation.idleSubtitle: Open a route to check it.
validation.idle: No route is open, so nothing has been checked yet.
validation.notCheckedBody: No complete reference list ships for {{lists}}, so those checks were skipped rather than guessed.
validation.ready: This route has nothing that needs fixing.

save.blocked: Fix the problems listed under Checks first.
save.packsDirty: Repack {{packs}} to put the route in the game.
